title: Thinner then expected- solid for dorm use!
text:
Thinner then expected- solid for dorm use!. Ordered blue, gray and white stripe which was a solid combination for use in the dorm with other roommates and variety of basic colors makes this very adaptable to any decor and colors scheme.. such a decent option for our college students! This thick enough to be soft and inviting to stand on- and thin enough so, it’s perfect for absorbing water after shower. Quick drying for others who’ll use afterwards in shower rotation.. a nice happy medium.
The solid construction and standard style make it easy for them to toss into the wash without need for delicate handling instructions.. ha! they’re in college- washing is not a priority!! Loving the stripes are forgiving for showing signs of wear and tear… Hoping this lasts them a bit before having to replace.
Would recommend as a solid straightforward option with versatile ability to adapt. At $20 we should definitely get moneys worth and have it look and feel nice while doing so! Hoping this info can help your decision.. stay safe!

product_metadata.title: Bathroom Rug Mat | Cotton Bathroom Mat/Rug | Soft, Absorbent & Durable Plush Rug | Easy Clean Modern Bath Mats Ideal for Bathroom, Toilet, Entrance & Living Room, 20X32 Inches, Yellow
features: EXTREMELY SOFT FEEL - 100% cotton bath mat will feel soft against your feet keeping them gentle and soft. These long stylish runners are constructed with soft, absorbent, 100% cotton material to soak up excess water on floors after exiting the tub or shower.

DIMENSIONS: Pack include 1 unit of 20X32 Inches; These bath rugs are highly durable. The attractive and classic square loop design of this shower mat naturally matches any color scheme, providing long-lasting soft feel for the whole family.

HIGHLY DURABLE AND ABSORBENT- This durable bathroom rug is what you need to protect your feet from cold floor as well as wet bathroom floor,to keep you more safe and cozy. Do not place mat on wet surface. The absorbent Sheen Decor bath rug provides the ultimate in plush softness with a thick sheared surface that is exceptionally smooth to the touch.
MULTIPLE USE - This is a multi-functional rug. Put them in living room, outside of bathroom to absorb water, in the entry way to keep the dust away from your house.

CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Machine Wash Gentle Cycle, Machine wash separately in cold water. Use mild detergent. Do not bleach or dry clean. Do not use fabric softeners or dryer sheets. Do not wring, line dry for best results.
